tone.target: tight British metal crunch with biting upper mids
tone.profile: tight British metal crunch with biting upper mids
tone.summary: A high-gain, mid-focused chain utilizing a Boost and Distortion to achieve the aggressive crunch of classic Judas Priest, paired with a Marshall-style amp and 4x12 cab.

rig.name: Judas Priest - Screaming For Vengeance - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Tightening the aggressive palm-muted rhythm playing by suppressing hum and noise.
Providing the necessary bite and aggressive attack boost for palm-muted riffs (TS-style boost emulation).
blocks.gap: The Boost module is used to emulate a TS/OD pedal's mid-hump without dedicated model selection.

alternatives.reason: If more grit than pure boost is desired.

blocks.purpose: Establishing the core high-gain crunch and bite required for British metal.
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model is chosen over specific amp models to maintain control of the overall tone structure before the main preamp stage.

alternatives.reason: For a more aggressive, mid-scooped crunch.

blocks.purpose: Emulating the classic Marshall/Plexi-style British rock tone, focusing on upper mids and bite.
Providing the classic British rock cabinet sound and necessary voicing for the genre.
Boosting the upper mids and treble to achieve the 'biting' quality while keeping the low end tight.
Included as a potential subtle texture layer for verses, but kept inactive to maintain the aggressive core tone.
blocks.gap: The Chorus is generally avoided in this genre/style, so it is set to inactive. It serves as an optional module slot.

blocks.purpose: Adding subtle depth and space for fills without muddying the tight rhythm tone.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better capture the vintage Marshall sound required for classic metal.

proposals.reason: Enhance the authentic British rock voicing and bite missing from the default IR.
